reviews.text:
Despite a couple of back-to-back cancelled appointments from McD's end I, ultimately, had a very positive experience. My pre-booked taxi didn't arrive, which made me late for my appointment, but McD still managed to slot me in, which I very much appreciated.
The vet, Caroline Grant, was very professional and efficient in seeing to Muńeca and the receptionist, too, was accommodating and helpful throughout, including booking my next appointment and taking into consideration Muńeca's reactiveness towards other dogs
My dog Amber is a very nervous dog. She was seen promptly and professionaly by the kind and caring staff at McDonalds Vet. 5/5

Always great service fast efficient welcoming and affordable my dog Milo can be very vocal and excited and there great with him thanks them I can get tests done that I couldn't at the specialists due to the high cost so I'm very thankful just had our 6mo check in July 2026 very happy yet again with service received dogs bk to his best self very much appreciated again thank you 😊

I took my dog here this week for his vaccinations and we were seen by vet Lee. He can be nervous but she made sure he felt comfortable and was able to give the vaccinations quickly and calmly, even getting a waggy tail afterwards. Thanks again!
I am forever grateful that my dog was saved when he needed treatment for a serious issue. He is so nervous of being examined and he is treated with so much kindness.
This place takes care of my 2 cats amazing staff and are always caring to the cats
My first experience at the vet was comfortable relaxed and friendly staff and exceptionally vet Lee and Katie helped me with the paperwork side of things I  will recommend the vet to all my friends.
Staff are extremely friendly and helpful. It's easy to get an appointment and the practice is open in the evening during the week.

My previous review has been deleted but every customer & potential customer should know. My 5 year old dog was misdiagnosed by this vet resulting in a series of issues which ultimately resulted in his death.
The fact my review was deleted just cements the fact you know you are in the wrong here but Karen tried to downplay it. Don't leave it until an emergency to find out if your vet is any good.
These guys will make mistakes and then they will cover them up.
Unforgiveable.
An excellent vet practice with friendly and knowledgeable staff. The waiting area was nice and quiet when we visited which made my cat feel much less stressed. Thank you!

Had to visit McDonald's Vet yesterday and today for my wee lame cat. The team who've been on both days were excellent! The vet was lovely- very gentle with my timid cat and she properly listened to me. The nurse also had a lovely manner, putting me at ease. I'm very happy with the care wee Smilla received.
Really nice staff, helpful understanding and non- judgemental. Went above and beyond what I expected. Thanks!
Staff so friendly and dealt with my kitten lovely
Best vets and every one is so friendly and they are so good with my we dog wouldn't change going there as its a lovely  friendly  vets
Been to the Vet with my kitten BluBerry for vaccination. Great experience with the vet. And will be looking forward to our future consultations! Parking along the street is paid so be careful!
